Name: BEHAVIOR_PARAM_ST
Description:
Handles animation events, including attack frames or firing bullets.
Responsible for stamina consumption.
Note that in Elden Ring, SpEffects are applied directly from the animation.

Fields.Name: Behavior Variation ID
Fields.Description: Bookkeeping copy of the variation part of the row ID (the weapon's or NPC's Behavior Variation ID). The game doesn't read it: only the row ID matters.

Fields.Name: Behavior Judge ID
Fields.Description: Bookkeeping copy of the last three digits of the row ID: the behaviour judge ID entered in the animation's behaviour event. The game doesn't read it: only the row ID matters.

Fields.Name: Reference Type
Fields.Description: What Reference ID points to: 0 Attack (AtkParam_Pc for BehaviorParam_PC, AtkParam_Npc for BehaviorParam), 1 Bullet, 2 SpEffect. Attack and bullet behaviours also pass Category on to the attack.

Fields.Name: Reference ID
Fields.Description: The AtkParam, Bullet or SpEffectParam row this behaviour uses, picked by Reference Type. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Poise Cost
Fields.Description: Poise the character loses when the behaviour runs, taken from its current poise. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Stamina Cost
Fields.Description: Stamina spent when the behaviour runs. Multiplied by the character's SpEffect stamina-cost rates, by the weapon's Stamina Consumption Rate for weapon attacks, and by the low-stat penalty rate when the player doesn't meet the weapon's requirements; the result is rounded down. For a guard behaviour it is also added as a flat amount to the stamina lost when blocking.

Fields.Name: Durability Cost
Fields.Description: Weapon durability spent when the behaviour runs. When this is not 0 and the player's weapon has no durability left, the behaviour doesn't run.

Fields.Name: Category
Fields.Description: Which buffs and SpEffect attack-rate changes apply to this behaviour's attacks and bullets (the same kind as Goods and Magic SpEffect Category). 1 Right-Hand Weapon and 2 Left-Hand Weapon take buffs limited to that hand; 12 Active Weapon takes right-hand buffs, and left-hand buffs while the left weapon is two-handed; 9 Kick takes kick buffs; 3 Sorcery and 4 Incantation take sorcery or incantation buffs; 0, 5–8 take only unrestricted buffs.

Fields.Name: Hero Point Cost
Fields.Description: A legacy cost (Humanity in earlier games): the behaviour doesn't run when the player has fewer hero points than this.
